paragraphs: Rabbi Yudan son of Rabbi Yose.

Vayikra Rabbah 9:9 mentions him saying, “Great is peace, for the Holy One, blessed be He, is called Peace.” Hyman says this statement was copied from the Peace chapter of Derekh Eretz Zuta, which collects statements of great Tannaim; there it is Rabbi Yehoshua’s statement.
